newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish bonds set new record high.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bonds set new record high.

text.p: For the second day in a row, the Spanish bond market hit new record high, supported by a positive trend in the U.S. T-bond, while the spread over German bonds dipped to all-time low on Tuesday, dealers said.
At 1545 GMT, the 10-year December future contract was at 111.16, after hitting an all-time record at 111.25. The previous record was set on Monday morning at 111.14.
The 10-year spread over German Bunds declined to 135 basis points. It had opened this morning at 142 bps, after it testing its record low of 138 bps on Monday.
